- [LDET.5.7.3] Is **spatial author intent** — the rule written first wins,
  which is the same convention the language already uses for actions
  ([LLET.9.4]), `let` bindings ([LLET.9.3]) and `after` clauses
  ([LTAC.2.3]). Written order means something in DS, and rules are not the
  exception.
